async function run(
	groups: Row[][],
	other: Row[],
	read: (item: Row) => Promise<Row>,
) {
	for (const batch of groups) {
		const tasks: Promise<Row>[] = batch
			.filter((item) => item.enabled)
			.map(read);
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(tasks);
	}
	for (const batch of groups) {
		const tasks: Promise<Row>[] = other
			.filter((item) => item.enabled)
			.map(read);
		// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
		const rows = await Promise.all(tasks);
	}
}
